feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 24 July 2026 11:19am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 24 July 2026 at 11:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

There is a Strong Wind warning in operation for Saturday.


##Synopsis##

A ridge of high pressure covering the British Isles will decline, as low pressure centred near Iceland, drives associated frontal troughs across the Irish Sea later tonight & during Saturday.


##Wind##

West or southwest force 3 or 4 occasionally 5, increasing 5 or 6 later tonight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate later tonight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with patchy light rain and drizzle spreading from the northwest later tonight & Saturday morning.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, but occasionally moderate in any rain and drizzle later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest force 5 or 6, veering and decreasing west or northwest mainly 3 or 4 Saturday afternoon, but locally variable 3 or less around the Isle of Man. Then becoming west or southwest 3 or 4 in all waters later Saturday evening, before increasing west or northwest 5 or 6 overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly slight Saturday afternoon, then building slight or moderate again overnight into Sunday and mainly moderate Sunday morning.


##Weather##

Occasional rain and drizzle.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor at times in rain or drizzle.
